def etcdstart.etcdLeaseServedAt [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (m : lease.Mode) (addr : GoString)
    (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (ρ : ReqNames) (γr : ReadNames) (cid mid : w64) : IProp GF :=
  match m with
  | lease.Mode.none => etcdstart.etcdKVAt addr E ρ γr cid mid
  | lease.Mode.mono => etcdstart.etcdLeaseGrantAt addr E γr
  | lease.Mode.revocable => etcdstart.etcdLeaseGrantLiveAt addr s E γr
